description: Soul drops of the monsters on the Abyss maps (Chaotic Lower/Middle/Upper Reshanta): which pet's soul each monster gives. Taken from the monster's loot table, not from its name: the name suffix is often wrong (Abyss Klaw gives Klaw Scout, Abyss Sulfur Slime Contaminated Slime). Used by scripts/build_tester_data.py to link the monster placements to pets.
source: https://aion2.gaming.tools/npcs/<npcId> (loot table entries 'Soul: <pet> (Bound)'), monster lists of /maps/20, /maps/22, /maps/23; read 2026-10-04 in the browser, about 1 page per second
